sources.title: GitHub - ibm-granite/granite-4.0-language-models · GitHub
sources.snippet: The initial release of the Granite 4.0 models included three sizes—micro, tiny, and small—built on dense, dense-hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) hybrid architectures. Additional model sizes have been added gradually. We provide both base models (checkpoints after pretraining) and instruct models (checkpoints fine-tuned for dialogue, instruction following, helpfulness, and safety).
